Tooltip_SignalSmoke_Grenade: Throw it: colored smoke rises, visible from afar, for about a minute and a half by default (sandbox settings can change it). Zombies standing in the smoke lose sight of their target.
Tooltip_SignalSmoke_RoadFlare: Light it and place it on the ground: it burns red for about an hour of game time by default (sandbox settings can change it).
Tooltip_SignalSmoke_RoadFlareLit: Burning. On the ground it burns and lights its surroundings. Picked up, it gives no light but keeps burning down: place it back on the ground before it is spent.
Tooltip_SignalSmoke_Chemlight: Activate it and place it on the ground: a soft colored glow, silent and without smoke, for several hours by default (sandbox settings can change it). Once activated, it cannot be turned off.
Tooltip_SignalSmoke_ChemlightLit: Glowing. On the ground it lights its surroundings; picked up, it keeps glowing until it is spent.
Tooltip_SignalSmoke_ImprovisedSmoke: Throw it: colored smoke, shorter than a military smoke grenade. Homemade, it sometimes fizzles without smoke. Zombies standing in the smoke lose sight of their target.
